Captured the Grade 1 Sword Dancer at 12F last summer and posted a stellar 122 speed figure when third in the Breeders Cup Turf. Ground-saving inside draw perfectly suits his stalking gear over the wide outer turf course.

selections.name: Far Bridge
selections.reason: Proven marathon turf titan who captured the 2024 Joe Hirsch Turf Classic and Grade 1 Sword Dancer. Re-entered off a victory in the Grade 3 Pan American in March. Hall of Fame pilot John Velazquez knows how to time his patented sweeping late bid over the Belmont stretch.

selections.name: Program Trading (GB)
selections.reason: Three-time Grade 1 winner for elite turf router trainer Chad Brown. Ran a commendable third beaten only 1 1/4 lengths in the 12F Clement L. Hirsch Turf Classic at Saratoga last out. Possesses strong tactical speed to sit right off the lead.

selections.name: Minaret Station
selections.reason: Ascending 4-year-old colt exited a career-best effort when second by a neck in the Grade 1 Clement L. Hirsch over 1 1/2 miles. Jose Ortiz retains the mount and should have him forwardly placed into the sweeping far turn.

selections.name: Pride Of Arras (IRE)
selections.reason: Intriguing European invader conditioned by Ralph Beckett with regular rider Rossa Ryan making the journey. Demonstrated staying class winning over 12F at Kempton and York. Projects to control the early tempo as the main tactical speed threat.

contenders.handicapper_notes: Reigning Grade 1 Diana Stakes victress brings elite class credentials into this 10-furlong test. Fits Chad Brown turf route wheelhouse perfectly and possesses ideal tactical pressing speed to overcome the wide draw. Score capped at 88 due to inner turf pace geometry rule with a lone frontrunner signed on.

Projected lone early speed runner drawn perfectly inside in Post 2 on Belmont tight-turning inner turf course. Ran gallant runner-up races setting the pace in both the Grade 3 Waya and Grade 2 Glens Falls. John Velazquez will dictate uncontested splits on the front end.

Reigning Breeders Cup Filly and Mare Turf Grade 1 heroine possesses immense back-class. Trained by Bill Mott and signaled a sharp return to peak fitness with a bullet 4F workout in 48.00 at Belmont on September 26. Deep closer will be launching late in the 1,097ft home straight.

Chad Brown second-stringer piloted by Flavien Prat. Finished a close-up fourth in the Grade 1 Diana after tracking wide. Possesses European Group 1 pedigree and top-flight stamina, though must navigate a wide barrier draw into the initial bend.

Arnaud Delacour trainee won the Grade 3 Waya over this trip last out, edging Storm Miami along the rail. Secures the ground-saving rail draw once again and is a proven marathon stayer capable of hitting the board at value odds.

Dangerous European import who missed by a neck in the Grade 2 Ballston Spa at Saratoga posting a massive 105 speed figure. Top British rider Rossa Ryan takes the mount and she draws perfectly inside to stalk the lone leader.
